40010105.author: पदार्थः
40010105.content: विमलं clear, गतविद्युद्वलाहकम् free from clouds and lightning, सारसाकुलसङ्घुष्टम् cackling of herons, रम्यज्योत्स्नानुलेपनम् lovely moonlight, व्योम sky, समृद्धार्थम् rich, मन्दधर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहम्  slow in attaining dharma and artha, अत्यर्थम् excessively, असताम् bad persons, मार्गम् path, एकान्तगतमानसम् engaged in fulfilling desires only, निर्वृत्तकार्यम् satisfied with his work, सिद्धार्थम्  accomplished, सदा all the time, प्रमदाभिरतम् engrossed in enjoyment of women, अभिप्रेताम् coveted, स्वां पत्नीम् his own wife, सर्वान् एव all, मनोरथान् desires, समीप्सिताम्  desired, तारां चापि Tara also, प्राप्तवन्तम् having obtained, अहोरात्रम् day and night, विहरन्तम्  strolling, कृतार्थम् accomplished, विगतज्वरम् without worry, नन्दने अप्सरसाम् with Apsaras in Nandana garden, गणैः groups, क्रीडन्तम्  sporting, देवेशम् इव like god Indra, मन्त्रिषु to the ministers, न्यस्तकार्यं च entrusting duty, मन्त्रिणाम् of the ministers, अनवेक्षकम् not watchful, उत्सन्नराज्यसन्देशम् without minding the duties of the kingdom, कामवृत्तम् इव as if engrossed in sensual pleasures, (अव) स्थितम् remaining, हरीशम् monkey king, सुग्रीवं च Sugriva, समीक्ष्य seen, निश्चितार्थः knower of responsibilities, अर्थतत्त्वज्ञः knower of principles, कालधर्मविशेषवित्  aware of duties to be performed at right time, वाक्यवित् skilful in expression, मधुर: sweet, मारुतात्मजः son of the windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, वाक्यतत्त्वज्ञम्  good at speech, हरीश्वरम् Sugriva, उपागम्य went to, मधुरै: with sweet, हेतुमद्भिः reasonable, मनोरमैः pleasing, वाक्यैः words, प्रसाद्य making happy, हितम् wellmeaning, तत्त्वम् truth, पथ्यम् च helpful, सामधर्मार्थनीतिमत् conciliatory, righteous, just and truthful words, प्रणयप्रीतिसंयुक्तम्  full of affection, विश्वासकृतनिश्चयम् having decided to take him into confidence, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40010105.author: Translation
40010105.content: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, saw the clear sky flooded with lovely moonlight, free from clouds and lightning and cackling of herons. He noticed that because Sugriva had attained abundant wealth and merit, he was not taking care of the kingdom. He was engrossed in sensual pleasures. Having accomplished the desired object, he was engaged in enjoyment of the company of women, his own wives and Tara, whom he coveted. He was strolling (in the pleasant garden) night and day without caring for the kingdom, entrusting it to the ministers whose movements he did not watch. He was sporting with women like Indra sports with apsaras in the Nandana garden.Hanuman, who was conscious of his duties and responsibilities, who was aware of the importance of action in time and who was skilful in speech approached Sugriva, king of the monkeys. Having decided to take him into confidence, Hanuman spoke in a convincing, wellmeaning, sweet, pleasing manner words truthful and helpful, conciliatory and just, full of love and affection:

40010105.author: सारांशः
40010105.content: Hanuman awakens Sugriva from slumber -- advises to initiate the search Vaidehi.

40010106.author: पदार्थः
40010106.content: विमलं clear, गतविद्युद्वलाहकम् free from clouds and lightning, सारसाकुलसङ्घुष्टम् cackling of herons, रम्यज्योत्स्नानुलेपनम् lovely moonlight, व्योम sky, समृद्धार्थम् rich, मन्दधर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहम्  slow in attaining dharma and artha, अत्यर्थम् excessively, असताम् bad persons, मार्गम् path, एकान्तगतमानसम् engaged in fulfilling desires only, निर्वृत्तकार्यम् satisfied with his work, सिद्धार्थम्  accomplished, सदा all the time, प्रमदाभिरतम् engrossed in enjoyment of women, अभिप्रेताम् coveted, स्वां पत्नीम् his own wife, सर्वान् एव all, मनोरथान् desires, समीप्सिताम्  desired, तारां चापि Tara also, प्राप्तवन्तम् having obtained, अहोरात्रम् day and night, विहरन्तम्  strolling, कृतार्थम् accomplished, विगतज्वरम् without worry, नन्दने अप्सरसाम् with Apsaras in Nandana garden, गणैः groups, क्रीडन्तम्  sporting, देवेशम् इव like god Indra, मन्त्रिषु to the ministers, न्यस्तकार्यं च entrusting duty, मन्त्रिणाम् of the ministers, अनवेक्षकम् not watchful, उत्सन्नराज्यसन्देशम् without minding the duties of the kingdom, कामवृत्तम् इव as if engrossed in sensual pleasures, (अव) स्थितम् remaining, हरीशम् monkey king, सुग्रीवं च Sugriva, समीक्ष्य seen, निश्चितार्थः knower of responsibilities, अर्थतत्त्वज्ञः knower of principles, कालधर्मविशेषवित्  aware of duties to be performed at right time, वाक्यवित् skilful in expression, मधुर: sweet, मारुतात्मजः son of the windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, वाक्यतत्त्वज्ञम्  good at speech, हरीश्वरम् Sugriva, उपागम्य went to, मधुरै: with sweet, हेतुमद्भिः reasonable, मनोरमैः pleasing, वाक्यैः words, प्रसाद्य making happy, हितम् wellmeaning, तत्त्वम् truth, पथ्यम् च helpful, सामधर्मार्थनीतिमत् conciliatory, righteous, just and truthful words, प्रणयप्रीतिसंयुक्तम्  full of affection, विश्वासकृतनिश्चयम् having decided to take him into confidence, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40010106.author: Translation
40010106.content: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, saw the clear sky flooded with lovely moonlight, free from clouds and lightning and cackling of herons. He noticed that because Sugriva had attained abundant wealth and merit, he was not taking care of the kingdom. He was engrossed in sensual pleasures. Having accomplished the desired object, he was engaged in enjoyment of the company of women, his own wives and Tara, whom he coveted. He was strolling (in the pleasant garden) night and day without caring for the kingdom, entrusting it to the ministers whose movements he did not watch. He was sporting with women like Indra sports with apsaras in the Nandana garden.Hanuman, who was conscious of his duties and responsibilities, who was aware of the importance of action in time and who was skilful in speech approached Sugriva, king of the monkeys. Having decided to take him into confidence, Hanuman spoke in a convincing, wellmeaning, sweet, pleasing manner words truthful and helpful, conciliatory and just, full of love and affection:

40010106.author: सारांशः
40010106.content: Hanuman awakens Sugriva from slumber -- advises to initiate the search Vaidehi.

40010107.author: पदार्थः
40010107.content: राज्यम् kingdom, यशश्चैव and fame, प्राप्तम् attained, कौली of the family, श्रीः prosperity, अभिवर्धिता heightened, मित्राणाम् of friends, सङ्ग्रहः earning good will, शेषः remains, तम् that( duty), भवान् by you, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हति  is proper

40010107.author: Translation
40010107.content: 'You have attained the kingdom. You have earned fame. The prosperity of your family has gone up. All that remains is to earn the goodwill of friends. Attend to that  now.

40010108.author: पदार्थः
40010108.content: यो हि he who, कालज्ञः knows the value of time, सततम् always, मित्रेषु towards friends, साधु  well, वर्तते conducts, तस्य his, राज्यं च kingdom and, कीर्तिश्च fame, प्रतापश्च glory, वर्धते will increase.

40010108.author: Translation
40010108.content: 'The kingdom, glory and fame of a king who knows the value of time and conducts himself well towards his allies always grows.

40010109.author: पदार्थः
40010109.content: भूमिप O king, यस्य he who, कोशश्च treasury, दण्डश्च and sceptre, मित्राणि allies, आत्मा च and his own self, समवेतानि are equally dear सर्वाणि all, सः he, महत् great, राज्यम् kingdom, अश्नुते will get.

40010109.author: Translation
40010109.content: 'He to whom the treasury, sceptre, allies and his own self all these are equally dear,  enjoys a large kingdom.

40010110.author: पदार्थः
40010110.content: तत् therefore, वृत्तसम्पन्नः endowed with right conduct, भवान् you, निरत्यये devoted, स्थितः  conforming to, अभिनीतार्थम् a proper course of action, मित्रार्थम् for the cause of ally यथावत् duly, कर्तुम् doing, अर्हति it is proper.

40010110.author: Translation
40010110.content: 'Endowed with right conduct, you ought to duly answer the cause of your ally conforming to proper course of action.

40010111.author: पदार्थः
40010111.content: यः whoever, सर्वकर्माणि all his deeds, सन्त्यज्य by giving up, सम्भ्रमात् with excitement, कृतोत्साहः with enthusiasm, मित्रार्थे for the sake of ally, अनुवर्तते does follow, सः to him, अनर्थैः harms, न अवरुध्यते not obstructed.

40010111.author: Translation
40010111.content: 'Whoever sets aside his personal interest and works for the welfare of his ally with due enthusiasm and excitement  will not be harmed.

40010112.author: पदार्थः
40010112.content: यः he who, कालव्यतीतेषु exceedng the time limit, मित्रकार्येषु in his friend's task, वर्तते acts, सः he, महतः great, अर्थान् effort, कृत्वा does, मित्रार्थेन for the cause of  friend, न युज्यते not  succeed.

40010112.author: Translation
40010112.content: 'He who exceeds the time limit in accomplishing a friend's task, and puts forth great effort later succeeds not.

40010113.author: पदार्थः
40010113.content: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, नः for us, तत् that, इदम् this, वीरकार्यम् heroic deed, मित्रकार्यम् for the sake of friend, वैदेह्यः Vaidehi's, परिमार्गणम् search, राघवस्य Rama's, एतत् this, क्रियताम् may be done, अरिन्दम O crusher of enemies, वीर hero, तत् that, इदम् this, कार्यम् task, ते to you, कालातीतम् already delayed.

40010113.author: Translation
40010113.content: 'O subduer of enemies we should do the brave deed of finding Vaidehi for the sake of your friend. O crusher of enemies this is your duty at present and it is already delayed.

40010114.author: पदार्थः
40010114.content: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, नः for us, तत् that, इदम् this, वीरकार्यम् heroic deed, मित्रकार्यम् for the sake of friend, वैदेह्यः Vaidehi's, परिमार्गणम् search, राघवस्य Rama's, एतत् this, क्रियताम् may be done, अरिन्दम O crusher of enemies, वीर hero, तत् that, इदम् this, कार्यम् task, ते to you, कालातीतम् already delayed.

40010114.author: Translation
40010114.content: 'O subduer of enemies we should do the brave deed of finding Vaidehi for the sake of your friend. O crusher of enemies this is your duty at present and it is already delayed.

40010115.author: पदार्थः
40010115.content: राजन् O king, प्राज्ञः a wise person, कालवित् one who is aware of the importance of timely action, सः he, त्वरमाणोऽपि even if he is in a hurry, तव your, वशानुगः staying( in your kingdom), अतीतम् exceeding, कालम् time, ते to you, न निवेदयति will not report.

40010115.author: Translation
40010115.content: 'O king a wise man (like Rama) who is aware of timely action would not tell you even if it is unduly delayed, even when he is in a hurry to get the work done, since he is staying in your kingdom (since he is dependant on you).

40010116.author: पदार्थः
40010116.content: राघवः Rama, स्फीतस्य prosperity, कुलस्य of your family, हेतुः responsible, दीर्घबन्धुश्च a long time ally, स्वयम् yourself, अप्रमेयप्रभावश्च a man of immeasurable power, गुणैः in virtues, अप्रतिमः peerless.

40010116.author: Translation
40010116.content: 'Rama is  responsible in lending stability to you and to your wellknown family. He will continue to be your ally for a long time. Let it be known that his power is boundless and his virtues peerless.

40010117.author: पदार्थः
40010117.content: हरीश्वर O king of monkeys, पूर्वम् earlier, तेन by him, तव to you, कृतम् done, त्वम् you, तस्य his, कार्यम् task, कुरु वै you may do, कपिश्रेष्ठान् आज्ञापयितुम् to order the best of monkeys, अर्हसि it will be proper for you.

40010117.author: Translation
40010117.content: 'O king pray accomplish his object the same way he has accomplished your own. You ought to issue orders to the foremost of the monkeys.

40010118.author: पदार्थः
40010118.content: चोदनादृते before prompting, कालः time, व्यतीतः elapsed न तावत् भवेत् cannot be used, चोदितस्य if he directs, कार्यस्य the task, कालव्यतिक्रमः time limit has elapsed, भवेत् will happen.

40010118.author: Translation
40010118.content: 'Time will not be deemed lapsed in vain if the work is sincerely taken up without delay and without pressure from your ally, Rama. If it is undertaken under pressure, it will be considered transgression of time.

40010119.author: पदार्थः
40010119.content: हरीश्वर O lord of monkeys, कार्यस्य of the task, अकर्तुरपि even if one has not done the task, भवान् you, कर्ता doer, धनेन च  wealth and, राज्येन च also kingdom, ते to you, प्रतिकर्तु: who performs the task in return, किं पुनः what to say again?

40010119.author: Translation
40010119.content: 'O lord of monkeys help even a person who has not helped you. As such, do you need to be told that you should help one, with whose help you have earned wealth and kingdom?

40010120.author: पदार्थः
40010120.content: वानरर्क्षगणेश्वर O protector of the monkey force, शक्तिमान् powerful, विक्रान्तः advancing forward, दाशरथेः Dasaratha's Rama, प्रीतिम् pleasure, कर्तुम् to do, अज्ञायाम् in issuing orders, किं न सज्जसे why do you not get ready?

40010120.author: Translation
40010120.content: 'O protector of the monkeys, you are powerful and you are prompt. Why don't you issue orders which will please Rama?

40010121.author: पदार्थः
40010121.content: दाशरथिः Rama, शरैः with arrows, सुरासुरमहोरगान् gods or demons and nagas, वशे under control, कर्तुम् to do, कामम् indeed, शक्तः खलु he has the capacity, त्वत् प्रतिज्ञाम् your swearing, हि indeed, काङ्क्षते he is looking for.

40010121.author: Translation
40010121.content: 'Indeed, Rama is fully capable of subduing gods, demons as well as nagas with his arrows. He is looking for your help in view of your promise.

40010122.author: पदार्थः
40010122.content: प्राणत्यागाविशङ्केन risking his life without hesitation, तेन by him, तव your, प्रियम् dear, कृतम् work, तस्य his, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, पृथिव्याम् on  earth, अम्बरेऽपि च or in heaven, मार्गाम let us search.

40010122.author: Translation
40010122.content: 'He has done you a deed dear to you without hesitation, risking his own life.Let us help him in search of his Vaidehi whether she is on earth or in heaven.

40010123.author: पदार्थः
40010123.content: देवदानव गन्धर्वा gods, demons or gandharvas, न मरुद्गणाः or marutas, असुराः deities, यक्षाः च and yakshas, तस्य for him, भयम् fright, न कुर्युः not cause, राक्षसाः demons, किमुत what to say of.

40010123.author: Translation
40010123.content: 'Not gods, demons, gandharvas or even marutas, suras or yakshas can cause fright in him much less the rakshasas.

40010124.author: पदार्थः
40010124.content: पिङ्गेश O king of monekys तत् that, एवं शक्तियुक्तस्य exerting all your strength, पूर्वम्  earlier, तव your, प्रियकृतः done the work desired by you, रामस्य Rama's, सर्वात्मना  wholeheartedly, प्रियम् dear, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि will be proper.

40010124.author: Translation
40010124.content: 'Therefore, O king of monkeys you ought to oblige Rama wholeheartedly exerting all your strength, as he has done your work.

40010125.author: पदार्थः
40010125.content: कपीश्वर O lord of monkeys, तव your, आज्ञया by orders, अस्माकम् for us, कस्यचित् of any place, अधस्तात् underground, सज्जते made possible, अवनौ on the earth, अप्सु in water, न or, उपरि up , अम्बरे च and in the sky, न or else.

40010125.author: Translation
40010125.content: 'O lord of monkeys commanded by you, each one of us or all of us together can ransack the underworld, the earth, or water or heaven.

40010126.author: पदार्थः
40010126.content: अनघ sinless hero, तत् therefore, आज्ञापय you order, कः who, किं what, कुत:from where,  व्यवस्यतु determine to act, ते your, कोट्यग्रतः more than a crore, अप्रधृष्याः invincible, हरयः vanaras, सन्ति हि at your service.

40010126.author: Translation
40010126.content: O sinless hero therefore issue your command. There are more than a crore of invincible monkeys. Determine  now who should  do and what and in which place. We are at your service'.

40010127.author: पदार्थः
40010127.content: तस्य his, काले at proper time, साधु honest, निवेदनम्  advice, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः one who has great sense of duty, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, उत्तमाम् best, मतिम् mind, चकार set on.

40010127.author: Translation
40010127.content: Sugriva who had a great sense of duty, started applying  his mind, when he heard the honest advice of Hanuman.

40010128.author: पदार्थः
40010128.content: अभिमतम् his favourite one, सर्वासु in all, दिक्षु in directions, सर्वेषाम् of all vanaras, सैन्यानाम् army cadres, उपसङ्ग्रहे to gether, नित्यकृतोद्यमम्  ever diligent, नीलम् Nila, सन्दिदेश sent

40010128.author: Translation
40010128.content: He sent word to the ever diligent Nila, his favourite, to collect all cadres of army of the monkeys from all directions.

40010129.author: पदार्थः
40010129.content: मे my, समग्रा all, सेना army, यूथपालाश्च group leaders, सर्वशः all over, असङ्गेन independently, यथा as, सेनाग्राणि O hero of the army, समागच्छन्ति will be assemble, तथा like that, कुरु you may act.

40010129.author: Translation
40010129.content: 'Let the entire army with leaders of different groups assemble here seperately. O chief of army act accordingly.

40010130.author: पदार्थः
40010130.content: अन्तपालाः chiefs, सैन्यं army, शीघ्रगाः swiftfooted, व्यवसायिनः  guardians of frontiers, ये प्लवगाः monkeys, ते they, मम my, शासनान् orders, त्वरिताः quickly, सैन्यं army, समानयन्तु may get here, अनन्तरं कार्यम् the task to be done later, भवान् you, एव only, स्वयम् personally, अनुपश्यतु  supervise.

40010130.author: Translation
40010130.content: 'Let the swiftfooted monkeys, guardians of frontiers, army chiefs muster soon in obedience to my command. You (Nila) alone should personally  supervise the work to be done next.

40010131.author: पदार्थः
40010131.content: यः वानरः such vanara, त्रिपञ्चरात्रात् after three or five nights, ऊर्ध्वम् over and above, इह here, प्राप्नुयात् may reach, तस्य his, प्राणान्तिकः  death sentence, दण्डः punishment, अत्र here, विचारणाः thought, न कार्या  no doubt

40010131.author: Translation
40010131.content: For any monkey who fails to arrive here after fifteen nights, the punishment is death; there is no question about it.

40010132.author: पदार्थः
40010132.content: साङ्गदः along with Angada, भवान् you, मम my, आज्ञाम्र orders, अधिकृत्य concerning, निश्चिताम् decidedly, वृद्धान् elderly, हरीन् monkeys, उपयातु approach, वीर्यवान् valiant, हरिपुङ्गवेश्वरः lord of monkeys, इति thus, व्यवस्थाम् arrangement, विधाय by making, वेश्म his residence, प्रविवेश entered.

40010132.author: Translation
40010132.content: 'In strict obedience to my orders, go with Angada to the elderly monkeys and inform them about my decision and order'. After making this arrangement valiant Sugriva entered his residence. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyninth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.
